title: RentGuard Service Charge Relief on an Installment Collected Early
content:
**Training note — service charge relief when a RentGuard Renters Policy installment is collected with a catch-up payment**

The rule: service charge relief on an installment collected early — when the next scheduled installment is collected with the catch-up and the whole months from the renters original effective date to today are 36 or more, its installment service charge is waived in full; when they are 24 or more but fewer than 36, half of that service charge is waived; when they are fewer than 24, or no installment is collected early, nothing is waived. The amount waived is taken off the catch-up amount.

**Which service charge is meant?**
The installment service charge collected with the next scheduled installment when that installment is taken with the catch-up.

**How is tenure counted?**
In whole months from the renters policy's original effective date (its first inception, not the start of the current term) to today.

**What is waived at each tenure?**

| Next scheduled installment collected with the catch-up? | Whole months since original effective date | Waived (taken off the catch-up) |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 36 or more | The whole installment service charge |
| Yes | 24 to 35 | Half of the installment service charge |
| Yes | Fewer than 24 | Nothing |
| No | Any | Nothing |

**Where are the edges?**
23 whole months waives nothing, 24 waives half; 35 whole months waives half, 36 waives the whole charge.

**Hypothetical example.** A next scheduled installment collected early with a hypothetical 3.00 USD service charge: at 30 whole months, 1.50 USD is taken off; at 40 whole months, 3.00 USD.
